entries.he: מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לְדַבֵּק אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, עַד שֶׁיֵּלֵךְ בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ מֵהֵיכָל אֶל הֵיכָל וְיִרְאֶה אֶת הַהֵיכָלוֹת בְּעֵינֵי הַשֵּׂכֶל, יִשְׁמֹר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִלּוֹמַר שֶׁקֶר אֲפִלּוּ בְּטָעוּת.
entries.en: 1. One who wants to attach himself to the Blessed G-d, to the extent that he can traverse with his thoughts from Haichal to Haichal (chamber to chamber), and to see the haichaloas (chambers) with the eyes of the intellect, must guard himself from saying falsehood, even by mistake.

entries.he: מֻתָּר לְשַׁנּוֹת בִּדְבַר הַשָּׁלוֹם.
entries.en: 2. It is permissible to alter [the truth] for the sake of peace.

entries.he: כַּת שַׁקָּרִים אֵינָם מְקַבְּלִים פְּנֵי הַשְּׁכִינָה.
entries.en: 3. The grouping of liars cannot receive the countenance of the Divine Presence.

entries.he: שָׁרֵי לְהוּ לְצַדִּיקַיָּא לִסְגוּאֵי בְּרַמָּאוּתָא עִם רַמָּאֵי.
entries.en: 4. It is permissible for the tzadikim to act with conniving with a swindler.

entries.he: כָּל הַמּוֹסִיף גּוֹרֵעַ.
entries.en: 5. All who add, detract.

entries.he: עַל יְדֵי שֶׁקֶר בָּאִים הִרְהוּרֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה.
entries.en: 6. Through falsehood come thoughts of idolatry (similary see article 28).

entries.he: עַל־יְדֵי אֱמֶת לֹא יָמוּת קֹדֶם זְמַנּוֹ הַקָּצוּב.
entries.en: 7. Through truth, one will not die before his allotted time.

entries.he: מָשִׁיחַ אָז לֹא יִהְיֶה שֶּׁקֶר, וּבִשְׁבִיל זֶה לֹא יִהְיֶה יֵצֶר הָרָע בָּעוֹלָם.
entries.en: 8. From the breath (of the mouth) of a liar, the evil inclination is created, and when the Messiah comes, (then) there will be no falsehood, and consequently, there will be no evil inclination in the world.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ אֱמֶת, אֲזַי הוּא מַכִּיר בְּאַחֵר, אִם אַחֵר דּוֹבֵר שֶׁקֶר אִם לָאו.
entries.en: 9. Someone who is a person of truth (then he) can discern in another, whether the other lies or not.

entries.he: הַסִּימָן שֶׁל הַשֶּׁקֶר - כְּשֶׁלֹּא יַסְכִּימוּ עָלָיו רַבִּים, וְהוּא מִשְּׁלֹשָׁה שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא שׂוֹנְאָן.
entries.en: 10. The indication of falsehood - when the many do not agree with it, and it is one of the three things that the Holy One Blessed be He hates.

entries.he: עָשִׁיר מְכַחֵשׁ - אֵין הַדַּעַת סוֹבְלוֹ וְהוּא נִבְזֶה בְּעֵינֵי עַצְמוֹ.
entries.en: 11. A rich man who denies (having the possessions of others) - the conscience cannot bear it, and he is despicable in his own eyes.

entries.he: אָדָם נִכָּר עַל־יְדֵי מְשָׁרְתָיו, אִם הוּא אוֹהֵב שֶׁקֶר כִּי זֶה בָּזֶה תָּלוּי. לִפְעָמִים מְשָׁרְתָיו נוֹפְלִים לַעֲבֵרוֹת עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁהוּא שַׁקְרָן, וְלִפְעָמִים הוּא נוֹפֵל לְשֶׁקֶר עַל־יְדֵי מְשָׁרְתָיו, שֶׁאֵינָם הֲגוּנִים.
entries.en: 17. A person is recognized through his servants, whether he loves falsehood, for each is dependent on the other. Sometimes his servants fall into sins through that which he is a liar, and sometimes he falls into falsehood through his servants, that aren't proper (-this teaching is brought succinctly in Faith 64).

entries.he: מִי שֶׁאוֹהֵב כְּזָבִים, הוּא מְבַזֶּה אֶת הַצַּדִּיק גַּם הוּא בְּעַצְמוֹ נִתְבַּזֶּה.
entries.en: 41. One who loves falsehood, he disgraces the Tzaddik, also, he himself becomes disgraced.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁדּוֹבֵר כְּזָבִים, הוּא אוֹבֵד.
entries.en: 42. One who speaks falsehood, he is lost.

entries.he: עַל־יְדֵי אֱמֶת נִצּוֹל מִלָּשׁוֹן־הָרָע גַּם תְּפִלָּתוֹ נִתְקַבֵּל. גַּם כְּשֶׁדָּנִים אוֹתוֹ לְמַעְלָה, דָּנִים אוֹתוֹ לְפִי זְכֻיּוֹת שֶׁלּוֹ.
entries.en: 43. Through truth, one is guarded from evil speech (lushon hura), also his prayer is accepted. Also, when he is judged above, he is judged according to his merits.

entries.he: עַל־יְדֵי חֲלוֹמוֹת יֵדַע אָדָם אִם לִבּוֹ אֱמֶת עִם אֱלֹקָיו.
entries.en: 44. Through dreams, a person can know if his heart is true with his G-d.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁמְּקַיֵּם דִּבּוּרוֹ, יָכוֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת פְּעֻלּוֹת.
entries.en: 45. Someone who keeps his word can be enterprising.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ גַּאֲוָה נִצּוֹל מִשָּׁקֶר.
entries.en: 46. Someone who doesn't have arrogance is saved from falsehood (see also article 16).

entries.he: מִי שֶׁשּׁוֹמֵר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִשְּׂחוֹק שֶׁל הִתּוּל, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ אֱמֶת.
entries.en: 47. Someone who guards himself from laughter of ridicule, it is certain that he is a person of truth.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁהָיָה שַׁקְרָן מִגִּלְגּוּל הֶעָבָר, עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה כְּשֶׁנִּתְגַּלְגֵּל, נַעֲשָׂה אִטֵּר־יָד.
entries.en: 48. One who was a liar in a previous incarnation, through this, when he was reincarnated, he was made to be left-handed.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁשּׁוֹמֵר אֶת עַצְמוֹ וְדוֹבֵר תָּמִיד אֱמֶת, כְּאִלּוּ עָשָׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ וְאֶת הַיָּם וְאֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּם.
entries.en: 49. One who guards himself and speaks truth at all times, it is as if he made the heavens and earth, and the sea and all that is in them (see also Likutay Moharan 47).

entries.he: הַשֶּׁקֶר אֵינוֹ אֶלָּא בְּפִיו, אֲבָל לֹא בִּכְתָב.
entries.en: 50. [The] Falsehood is only with one's mouth, but not in writing.

entries.he: דִּבְּרוּ תּוֹרָה וּנְבִיאִים וַחֲכָמִים בִּלְשׁוֹן הֲבַאי.
entries.en: 51. The Torah, the Prophets and the Sages spoke in common terms (-this usually refers to exaggerations).

entries.he: עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁקֶר דְּבָרָיו אֵינָם נִשְׁמָעִים. גַּם עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁקֶר מְאַלְמֵן, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כַּמָּה נָשִׁים.
entries.en: 1. Through falsehood, one's words are not heard. Also, through falsehood, several women, G-d forbid, can become widowed.

entries.he: עַל־יְדֵי אֱמֶת נִתְגַּלֶּה יִחוּדוֹ בָּעוֹלָם.
entries.en: 2. Through truth, His unity is revealed in the world.

entries.he: כְּשֶׁאַתָּה רוֹאֶה שַׁקְרָן, תֵּדַע, שֶׁגַּם הַמַּנְהִיג שֶׁל הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה שַׁקְרָן.
entries.en: 3. When you see a liar, know that the leader of this person is also a liar.

entries.he: עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁקֶר בָּא לִידֵי גִּלּוּי־עֲרָיוֹת וּשְׁפִיכוּת־דָּמִים, וְגַם מַכְשִׁיל אֶת הַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּגִלּוּי־עֲרָיוֹת וּשְׁפִיכוּת־דָּמִים, וּמַרְאֶה הֶתֵּר מִן הַתּוֹרָה.
entries.en: 4. Through falsehood, one comes to sexual immorality and spilling of blood, and also causes the upright people to fail in sexual immorality and spilling blood, and he shows permissibility from the Torah.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְשַׁנֶּה בְּדִבּוּרוֹ, הוּא יָכוֹל לְהַשְׁפִּיל הַגְּבוֹהִים וּלְהַגְבִּיהַּ הַשְּׁפָלִים.
entries.en: 5. Someone who does not alter the truth with his words, he is able to humble the high and raise up the lowly (see article 1:45 and the notes there).

entries.he: מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְדַבֵּר אֶחָד בַּפֶּה וְאֶחָד בַּלֵּב, אֵינוֹ מִתְיָרֵא מִטְבִיעַת מַיִם.
entries.en: 6. One who does not speak one thing with his mouth and another (-while having a different) in his heart, does not fear from drowning [in water].

entries.he: הָאֱמֶת מֵבִיא שֹׂבַע.
entries.en: 7. The truth brings contentment (abundance).

entries.he: הַשִּׁלְשׁוּל וְהָעֲצִירוּת בָּא עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁקֶר.
entries.en: 8. Diarrhea and constipation come as a result of falsehood.

entries.he: עַל־יְדֵי אֱמֶת בָּא הַקֵּץ.
entries.en: 9. Through truth comes the end (-of the exile – redemption). (see Likutay Moharan, Torah-teaching 66:3 (also see Torah-teaching 7)).
